newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo allocates 12.5 bln Skr to market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo allocates 12.5 bln Skr to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated 12.5 billion crowns into the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week straight repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent and will run from April 23 to April 30.
It was the second week the bank has moved from a repurchase system to a straight repo.
This means the bank now buys government securities and other valid securities and will put them up for resale on April 30 rather than selling them and then buying them back later.
The week's operation replaces a repurchase operation that allocated 11.5 billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 42.66 percent of the bids for the new tender were allocated.
